candidate_query:
MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(s:Spec)
MATCH (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company)
WHERE split(coalesce(r.content, ''), '\nDecision:')[0] CONTAINS t.tdocNumber
WITH s.specNumber AS spec, c.companyName AS company, count(DISTINCT t) AS tdoc_count
ORDER BY spec ASC, tdoc_count DESC, company ASC
WITH spec, collect(company)[..10] AS contributors
RETURN spec, contributors ORDER BY spec ASC
